title: map.json
description: The Map's metadata. Names are the game's own; the Builder translates them with the Name Tables.

times_of_day.description: The Times of Day the game gives this Map. A Map with no Time of Day switch has all of its Game's.

camera.description: The Camera Profile whose settings the Grade and the sun shafts run with. The bundle names it; the settings are Game data (ADR 0010).

list_entries.description: The game list entries that show this Map. A Studio Map whose geometry is the same as a story Map's is an entry here, not a Map of its own (D22).

no.description: The entry's number in that list.

name.description: The entry's name, as the list has it.

display_name.description: The name the game shows, where the list has one apart from its name.

thumbnails.description: The game's own thumbnails, each for the Times of Day it shows.

geometry_hash.description: The Content Hash of the whole node tree, which tells two Maps with the same geometry apart from two that differ (D22).

skipped.description: What the Extractor saw and couldn't carry, counted.
